name: Hyliotidae
description: Hyliotas are a small family of African passerine birds that resemble warblers or flycatchers. They are active insectivores found in woodlands and savannas across sub-Saharan Africa.

children.name: Hyliota
children.description: A genus of small, active birds with blue-black or violet upperparts and pale underparts, found in African woodlands.

children.name: Hyliota flavigaster
children.description: The yellow-bellied hyliota (Hyliota flavigaster) is a species of Hyliota. It is found in Angola, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ivory Coast, Ethiopia, Gabon, Gambia, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Kenya, Malawi, Mali, Mozambique, Nigeria, Rwanda, Senegal, Sierra Leone, South Sudan, Tanzania, Togo, Uganda, and Zambia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical dry forests.

children.name: Hyliota australis
children.description: thumb|Southern Hyliota The southern hyliota (Hyliota australis) is a species of Hyliota.

children.name: Hyliota usambarae
children.description: The Usambara hyliota (Hyliota usambara) is a species of Hyliota.

children.name: Hyliota violacea
children.description: The violet-backed hyliota (Hyliota violacea) is a species of Hyliota. It is sparsely spread across the African tropical rainforest.
